description: This file contains the WebSiteWorker class which provides utility methods for retrieving website-related data, such as obtaining the website ID from a request, fetching website details from a database, and encapsulating website lookup logic in a Java-based web application.

classes.name: WebSiteWorker
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for interacting with website data in an OFBiz web application.

methods.name: getWebSiteId
methods.description: Retrieves the website ID from the servlet context associated with the incoming request.

methods.name: getWebSite
methods.description: Fetches the website entity (GenericValue) based on the website ID obtained from the request.

methods.name: findWebSite
methods.description: Performs a database lookup to find a website entity by website ID, with optional caching.
